data.name: Liquid-nitrogen cold trap
data.function: Charcoal-filled coil immersed in liquid nitrogen through which the circulating mixture passes before re-entering the fridge. It adsorbs air, water and oil that would otherwise freeze in the condensing impedance and block circulation, the most common cause of a slowly failing base temperature.

physics.summary: Cleans the circulating gas of contaminants.

data.tooltip: LN2 cold trap cleaning the mixture.
